semantics: Same received input; exact candidate/stop executed without further replanning for 0.8 s; future camera rays follow that candidate with bounded yaw. Privileged geometry used only for labels. Current-map validator and frame timestamps preserved.
limitations: Static ideal geometry, no controller error, finite 0.8 s future observation window, four sampled candidates per selected state; these are supervised branch labels, not complete RL returns.
records_note: Compact split/time/provenance index. Full queries and raw parent replays were removed under the retention policy; this package supports retraining, not reconstructing all original observations.
